blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW), which serves much of Iloilo City and nearby municipalities in Iloilo province, is ramping up preparations to mitigate the impact of a “super” El Niño expected to intensify between December and March. MPIW said it is preparing for a possible drop in water supply to 50 million liters per day (MLD) under a worst-case El Niño scenario, as it rolls out infrastructure projects and leak-reduction measures to help offset the expected shortage.
